# People (mama, papa, girl, brother) - sources and licences

Generated by `assets/people/scripts/build_people.sh` (Blender 4.2 + MPFB2). Nothing here depicts a real,
identifiable person: the four bodies are made from MakeHuman sliders.

## Humans, clothes base, eyes, hair, brows, lashes, teeth, rig
- MakeHuman / MPFB2 2.0.18 with the MakeHuman system assets (base mesh, targets, skins young_asian_female /
  young_asian_male, hair bob01 / bob02 / short02 / short03, eyebrow001, eyelashes01, high-poly eyes, teeth_base,
  male_casualsuit02 as the base of every top and pair of trousers, game_engine rig).
- Licence: **CC0 1.0** (MakeHuman's licensing page: exported models and the bundled system assets are CC0).
  https://static.makehumancommunity.org/mpfb.html - https://www.makehumancommunity.org/
- The MPFB2 add-on itself is GPL; it is only the tool and is not shipped.
- Textures were re-made from the CC0 originals (plain fabric colours, no logos or text; skin colour variation and
  ambient occlusion; dark natural hair). Collars, zippers, socks, shoes, the helmet with intercom headset and the
  harness are generated by the build scripts (no third-party assets).

## Motion
- Walk (07_01) and standing idle (111_28) are retargeted from the CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
  (cgspeed BVH conversion); all other clips (seated flying poses, waves, scarecrow poses, crouched work) are
  procedural / inverse kinematics.
- Licence (CMU): "This dataset of motions is free for all uses." You may include it in commercially sold products
  but may not resell the data directly.
- **Required acknowledgment (put this line in the game credits):**

  The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
